summary: Allows users to view outstanding fee dues across multiple academic sessions and filter by a minimum due amount or percentage.
navigation: Fees > Fee Reports > Multi-Session Due Fee Report
steps: Enter a minimum amount or percentage to filter dues (e.g., show dues greater than Rs. 10,000 or a certain percentage).
Click "Go" to display the filtered results.
business_rules: Can filter by minimum due amount or percentage.
important_notes: Useful for identifying students with significant outstanding dues for targeted communication (e.g., WhatsApp messages).
questions: How do I check outstanding dues across multiple academic sessions?
Can I filter the due fee report by a minimum due amount or percentage?
How can I identify students with high outstanding dues?
